items.title: Lionel Reason Interview, 1981-05-26
items.q: Interviewer mentions Nelly Lodger; Interviewee responds about Alan Freed and Paul Lee Barnes, and later mentions Nelly Lodger's father and brothers having their own band, but does not describe a direct personal or professional relationship with Nelly Lodger herself.

ctx.x: And they were French people. Yes. Oh, well, when Alan Freed and Paul Barnes were over there with Nelly Lodger and all those people, did you have a conductor?

Alan Freed was a conductor. Oh, I see. He was a conductor. Well, I wouldn't call it a conductor. I called it a director or an entertainer. And what is it? What is it? I just sat in the band and Paul Lee Barnes was the brain.
